title: try_send drop silently breaks SSE without client-visible reason
description: events_handler uses try_send; when the channel is full the task breaks and live_tx is dropped. The SSE stream ends (hyper closes the connection). The client sees a dropped connection with no HTTP error code or SSE error event. In production, a slow client will repeatedly reconnect, fill the channel again, and get dropped again — generating a flood of reconnections and log noise. Scenario: user on a slow network or with a battery-saving browser tab that throttles JS. Consequence: ghost reconnect loop; no actionable error for the user or logs beyond 'SSE receiver lagged'.
